# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A contraction of intraday volatility (ATR squeeze) around midday often precedes a breakout with volume expansion, offering a directional edge. The setup captures the tendency of SPY to compress in the 10:30‑12:00 window before resuming trend with increased participation.

## Mechanism

Compute ATR(5) on 5‑minute bars. If ATR(5) falls below its lowest value over the prior 20 periods between 10:30 and 12:00 ET AND price breaks above the high of the preceding 30 min with volume >1.5× the average volume of the last 20 bars, enter long at the breakout bar’s close. Exit: initial stop at the low of the breakout bar (or prior swing low), TP1 at 2×R, runner trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR×2.5). Regime filter: only consider when VIX <20 and after 11:00 ET to avoid lunch‑time chop; skip known FOMC or major news windows.
